Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Subject: Audio recording of earnings call of the Company for the quarter and 
half-year ended September 30, 2026 
 
This is further to our letter dated October 6, 2026 and October 14, 2026, we wish 
to inform you that pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Company had hosted an 
earnings conference call with investor(s) and analyst(s) on Wednesday,                    
October 14, 2026, to discuss the financial performance of the Company for the 
quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. 
 
The audio recording of the ‘earnings conference call’ has been hosted on the 
website 
of 
the 
Company

Thanking you. 
 
Yours Sincerely, 
 
For ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
